title: Document Controller
description:
Location: Maidstone
Rate: £20.00 - 22.00 per hour depending on experience
Contract: Freelance
Duration: 3 months

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking an experienced Document Controller to join our client's head office team and provide document control support across a number of live construction projects.

Working closely with project teams, design managers, site management, and subcontractors, you will be responsible for ensuring project documentation is accurately managed, distributed, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

- Ensure project records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Requirements
- Previous experience as a Document Controller within the construction industry.
- Strong working knowledge of Protec document management systems.
- Proven experience using Microsoft SharePoint.
- Experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

Desirable
- Experience working for a main contractor, developer, or residential construction business.
- Knowledge of design, technical, and construction documentation processes.
- Experience supporting large-scale residential, mixed-use, or commercial projects.

title: Office Administrator
description:
Job Title: Office Administrator

Location: Maidstone

Salary: 26,500 - 28,500 depending on experience.

Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Hours: Standard Office Hours are 8:30am - 17:30pm Mon-Fri.

RGVA provides a complete vehicle branding service from to design to installation, with clients including Domino's Pizza, Lidl, Currys and Nestle, our small but hard-working team are responsible for branding some of the UK's most well-recognised liveries. Over the last 25 years we have grown from our base in Maidstone, Kent, to become the only vehicle specific, full service graphic company in the UK, and we owe our success to our close-knit team who take great care of our ever-growing customer base.

About the Role

RGVA is looking for an organised, proactive Office Administrator to keep our office running smoothly and support our Operations Manager and fitting teams. This is a varied role at the heart of the business - spanning day-to-day invoicing and stock ordering through to compliance, scheduling, and vehicle fleet admin. You'll need to be comfortable juggling routine admin alongside more process-driven responsibilities like ISO9001 accreditation and Risk Assessments/Method Statements.

This role suits someone who likes structure, doesn't mind detail-heavy work, and wants genuine variety day to day.

What You'll Be Doing:

Office Administration & Finance:
- Invoicing jobs (full or progress-based) following completion of previous day's fitting
- Ordering stock for the fitting team and producing a monthly report for the MD
- Ordering general office supplies
- Collating fitters' hours from the ERP system for payroll
- Managing ISO9001 accreditation, including coordinating audits alongside the MD

Supporting the Operations Manager:
- Chasing subcontractor availability
- Checking photos and job details uploaded by the fitting team (chassis, temps, etc.)
- Creating and updating tracking sheets for completed installs
- Setting up customer and vehicle records in Simpro / HubSpot
- Reviewing previous day's deliveries - checking PODs, confirming on-site readiness for fitters, and recording for supply-only invoicing
- Coordinating H&S compliance - tracking when staff training (PASMA, IPAF, etc.) is due for renewal and booking the relevant courses (no requirement to deliver training yourself)
- Creating Risk Assessments & Method Statements
- Booking company vehicles in for servicing, MOTs, and road tax renewal
- Hours

Standard office hours: 8:30am - 5:30pm, Monday to Friday Plus Finish Early Fridays - 4:00pm finish if you take only a 30-minute lunch Wednesday-Friday.

What's on Offer
- Salary 26,500 - 28,500 depending on experience
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays, rising by 1 day at 5 years' service and again at 10 years'
- Death in service policy
- End-of-year company bonus
- Finish Early Fridays

What We're Looking For
- Strong organisational skills and comfort managing multiple ongoing tasks
- Confidence with office/ERP systems (training provided on Simpro/HubSpot if not already familiar)
- Good attention to detail - particularly for compliance, invoicing, and documentation
- A proactive, "gets on with it" attitude

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV and Cover Letter for this role.
Candidates with the relevant experience or job title of; Office Administrator, Administrator, Office Administration Assistant, Administration Clerk, Administrative Assistant, Office Coordinator, Receptionist, Secretary, Business Administrator, Support Administrator, Reception Administrator, Office Assistant, Office Coordinator, Office Manager, Business Administrator may also be considered for this role.

title: Heating & Plumbing Service Coordinator
description:
Know enough about boilers, heating and plumbing to work out what's actually wrong when a customer calls?

We need an experienced Service Controller to join an existing office-based team supporting a busy domestic engineering operation.

This isn't a standard customer service role.

You'll be the bridge between the customer and the engineer: understanding the problem, asking the right questions, providing straightforward first-line solutions where appropriate and deciding when an engineer needs to take over.

Think technical customer service meets second-line support meets engineer coordination.

You'll also help keep the operation moving, coordinating engineer diaries, arranging appointments and managing the quotation process. You won't be expected to technically price or produce quotations from scratch, but you will make sure the right information gets to the right people and that quotes reach customers.

Day to day, you'll be
- Handling incoming plumbing, heating and related service enquiries
- Diagnosing straightforward issues over the phone
- Talking customers through basic fixes where appropriate
- Identifying when an engineer visit is required
- Booking and coordinating engineer appointments
- Planning engineer diaries effectively
- Liaising between customers, engineers and the wider team
- Coordinating quotations and following them through
- Keeping customers updated and making sure nothing disappears into an inbox

What we're looking for

The key thing here is relevant industry knowledge.

You'll ideally have worked in a customer service, service desk, technical support, scheduling or service controller role within heating, boilers, plumbing, air conditioning or a closely related engineering environment.

You don't need to be an engineer yourself, but you do need enough technical understanding to recognise common problems, ask sensible questions and communicate effectively with both customers and engineers.

We're adding to an established team, so you'll have people around you who understand the operation. What we need is someone who can bring together technical understanding, customer service and organisation and keep a busy day running smoothly.

If you've worked behind the scenes keeping domestic engineers moving and customers informed, we'd like to hear from you

Reed Business Support are looking for a proactive Office Administrator to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys variety in their day and takes pride in being the person who keeps everything on track.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

As a valued member of the team, you'll play a key role in ensuring our office operates efficiently and professionally. You'll work alongside supportive colleagues in a positive environment where your contributions are recognised and appreciated.

Benefits include:
- Competitive salary.
- Flexible working arrangements.
- Ongoing training and development.
- Friendly and collaborative team culture.
- Employee wellbeing initiatives.
- Career progression opportunities.

Day-to-Day of The Role:

As our Office Administrator, you'll be responsible for:
- Managing incoming calls, emails and correspondence.
- Maintaining accurate records and company databases.
- Supporting managers and wider teams with administrative tasks.
- Coordinating meetings, diaries and travel arrangements.
- Preparing documents, reports and presentations.
- Ordering office supplies and managing stock levels.
- Ensuring office systems and processes run efficiently.
- Handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in an administrative or office support role.
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- The ability to multitask and prioritise workloads effectively.
- A positive, proactive and team-focused attitude.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

If you're looking for a rewarding opportunity where your organisational skills can make a real difference every day, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become an integral part of a business that values efficiency, teamwork and professional growth.

To apply, submit your CV now or contact us for more information.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator
Sevenoaks
30,000- 35,000 per annum
Office Based
Monday to Friday 9am-5:30pm
24 days annual leave, Pension, Company social events

We are delighted to be assisting this small but growing Security business to find the latest addition to their team. Once projects are won, they would be passed to you and 2 colleagues to manage the project to completion- from ordering materials, to organising work, replying to queries, quoting and invoicing. This is a highly varied role where you will have to work independently whilst liaising with several different departments and client contacts. This is a varied, hands-on role that combines administration, customer service, scheduling, and project support responsibilities.

Administration & Operations
- Manage day-to-day office administration across service and project activities.
- Maintain accurate job records, reports, and operational documentation.
- Support processes relating to quotations, orders, invoicing, and job management systems.
- Assist with compliance administration, including quality, health & safety, and industry standards.

Project & Resource Coordination
- Schedule engineers for installations, maintenance visits, and reactive call-outs
- Occasional attendance for site visits (mostly London and expensed)
- Monitor job progress and ensure completion records are maintained.
- Coordinate project delivery activities, including:
- Resource planning
- Equipment ordering and logistics
- Site documentation
- Travel and accommodation arrangements
- Project timelines and cost tracking
- Invoicing and project close-out support

Customer & Commercial Support
- Process quotations, orders, and invoices.
- Provide customers with updates on orders, services, and project progress.
- Ensure all queries are resolved or escalated promptly and professionally.

About You

You are highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy working collaboratively while taking ownership of tasks and seeing them through to completion.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Proven experience in a senior administrative, coordination, or project support role.
- Strong customer service and communication abilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook.
- Experience coordinating field-based teams, engineers, or operational resources.
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

Desirable Experience
- Experience with job management, ERP, or scheduling systems.
- Knowledge of security, engineering, technical services, or construction environments.
- Experience supporting quality, compliance, or health & safety processes.
- Understanding of project coordination and resource planning.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Are you a finance professional who enjoys working with data, improving processes and supporting business performance? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail and analytical thinking are key?Are you looking for an opportunity to develop your finance career within a leading logistics organisation?

Here at GXO, we're recruiting for a Finance Assistant to join our IKEA operation in Dartford on a fixed-term contract until end of May 2027. Working closely with the Finance Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting management accounting activities, financial reporting and maintaining robust financial controls across the contract.

This is a full-time position, working Monday to Friday, from 09:00 to 17:00 offering an excellent opportunity for someone looking to further develop their finance experience within a dynamic operational environment.

Pay, benefits and more:

We're offering a salary of up to £31,000 per annum, plus 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays). Your benefits package includes a company sponsored pension scheme, life assurance and access to our benefits platform, including retail discounts

What you'll do on a typical day:
- Support the production of weekly profit and loss reporting, providing accurate financial information and insight to support operational and commercial decision-making
- Prepare and post journals, including inter-departmental recharges and financial adjustments, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded
- Raise and process customer invoices while maintaining strong financial controls and ensuring compliance with agreed processes
- Reconcile balance sheet accounts, investigating discrepancies and resolving issues to maintain financial accuracy and integrity
- Create and maintain spreadsheets, reports and financial data models while supporting month-end activities and ad hoc projects across the finance function

What you need to succeed at GXO:
- Previous experience within a finance, accounting or financial administration role, with a solid understanding of financial processes and controls
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines
- Excellent Microsoft Excel and spreadsheet skills, with confidence working with financial data and reporting tools
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across departments
- Ideally AAT qualified, studying towards ACA, ACCA or CIMA, or qualified through relevant experience

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team - energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.
